lines.kart.title: KART
lines.kart.join: PLAYER 2: PRESS 2 OR START ON A PAD

notes.kart.title: The kart racer's title, on its menu.
notes.kart.menu.race: A mode: you against five CPU drivers.
notes.kart.menu.vs: A mode: two players in a split screen (VS: versus).
notes.kart.menu.back: Back to the title screen (a menu entry).
notes.kart.menu.again: After the race: race once more.
notes.kart.menu.menu: After the race: back to the kart menu.
notes.kart.join: 2 is the key on a keyboard, START the button on a gamepad: keep them as they are.
notes.kart.results.row: A row of the results: {place} is the finishing place (1 to 6, a plain number), {name} the driver's name.
notes.action.gas: Accelerate: an action's name on the controls screen.
notes.action.brake: An action's name on the controls screen and its touch button.
notes.action.drift: Hop into a bend and slide through it: an action's name on the controls screen and its touch button.
notes.action.item: Use the item you hold (a boost, a shell, a peel): an action's name on the controls screen and its touch button.

brief: The kart racer: Mode 7 karts in the spirit of Super Mario Kart. Six drivers (NOVA, LUMA, BRAKK, IRIS, TOK and ROOK: made-up names, gender not stated) race three laps of a meadow circuit, you against five CPU drivers or two players in a split screen. Arcade tone: short words in capitals.
